programme.name: Rewards

earn.basis: Eligible spend after discounts, before tax
earn.posting: Posted after the sale is confirmed in the till log (usually < 15 min). Offline sales post when the till reconnects.

rules: Redeem in blocks of 1,000 points ($5) as a tender at the till, online or in the app
Two-phase reserve → confirm, so points can't be spent twice
No redemption while the till is offline

expiry.rule: Points expire after 12 months without an earn or burn (rolling)

programme.tierRule: Tier = rolling 12-month eligible spend, reviewed monthly. Members keep a tier until the end of the next calendar year.

paid.name: Rewards Plus
benefits: 2% back on eligible spend as reward certificates each quarter

programme.returns: Returns reverse earned points in proportion to the refunded amount. Points burned on the sale are restored if the refund goes back to the original tender. Voids reverse everything.
programme.household: Up to 6 cards share one points balance. Any card holder can redeem; the primary member can remove cards.

fraudRules.detail: More than 3 stores in 60 minutes, or more than 8 transactions per day
Points earned or burned > 5x the member's 90-day average
Staff-linked cards earning on transactions rung by the same cashier
One card used across distant stores or many devices
Any manual adjustment needs a reason and a second approver (maker-checker)
